description: Golden retrieval set. Relevance is judged at document level: a query is answered correctly if the retrieved chunks come from a document listed in expected_document_ids. Categories mark what each query is meant to stress, so a regression can be traced to a query type rather than an average.

categories.literal: rare exact token — identifier, version, header name. Hardest for embeddings.
categories.keyword: shared vocabulary between query and document. Both branches should cope.
categories.paraphrase: same meaning, little or no lexical overlap. Hardest for BM25.
categories.inflection: Russian morphological variants of the document's wording.
categories.cross_lingual: Russian query against an English document.
categories.multi_doc: the answer legitimately spans more than one document.
